Convert a date range to composite DOY folders

Source: R/doy.R
glass_doys.Rd

GLASS composite products are stored in folders keyed by the day-of-year (DOY) at which a synthesis cycle starts, one set per year: /archive/<product>/<source>/<res>/<year>/<doy>/. glass_doys() computes which folders a calendar date range needs, for any cadence held in the registry.

Usage

glass_doys(variant_id, from, to, mode = c("span", "start"))

Arguments

variant_id

Registry variant key, e.g. "LAI_MODIS_250M" (used to look up cadence_days).

from, to

Start/end date as Date or YYYY-mm-dd string.

mode

How to treat folders that only partially overlap the range: "span" (default) keeps every composite whose interval intersects [from, to]; "start" keeps only composites starting inside the range. The legacy scripts used the equivalent of "start".

Value

A tibble with columns year, doy (integer, cycle start), date (start date of that cycle), folder (zero-padded sprintf folder name).

Examples

glass_doys("LAI_MODIS_250M", "2018-08-01", "2018-12-31")
#> # A tibble: 20 × 4
#>     year   doy date       folder
#>    <int> <int> <date>     <chr>
